cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama District 27 since November 2022. Former Auburn city councilmember. Auburn University graduate (B.S., 2001). Worked as a mortgage loan originator, property manager and realtor, and account manager. Describes himself as an Eagle Scout and former Auburn student firefighter.
cands.gaps: We found no bills he sponsored, since the list on his Ballotpedia page was empty. We found no documented stance on data centers, development or growth, homestead taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration or H-1B, police pay, or school choice and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for 2026. Details of his Auburn city council service, such as the ward and years, come only from Wikipedia and could not be confirmed elsewhere. His campaign website lists advisory and civic board roles, which are not counted as work experience.
